newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was steady to firmer on Wednesday as crude oil futures rose and supply shrank, traders said.
Two cargoes were heard sold on Tuesday at $107 fob Ireland and $107 fob Scandinavia. The latter was bought by a refiner in ARA.

High sulphur cargoes remained strong. An M-100 cargo from Klaipeda was heard sold on Tuesday to a Spanish refiner at $6.50 a tonne over the mean/mean of published quotes. This followed another M-100 sale on Monday at similar levels, traders said.
E-4 cargoes were scarce. "That is just as well because the price is too high," one refiner said.
